messages:
Asha Verma: pitching a 45m webinar: "Inference Economics: Practical Playbooks for Product & Platform". focus: topic selection, abstracts, speakers, rehearsals, run-of-show. goal = pipeline + 20 qualified demo asks. thoughts?
Ben Torres: strong. target PMs + infra/ML engs at scaleups. keep it practical + show concrete numbers.
Cara Liu: proposed speaker lineup: Asha (host + product framing), Ben (bench + numbers), Diego (runtime demo), Elena (customer short case), panel Q&A.
Diego Ramos: run-of-show idea:
```
00:00 - intro & outcomes (3m)
03:00 - quick taxonomy: hosted vs dedicated vs private (7m)
10:00 - cost levers: batching, caching, quant, routing (10m)
20:00 - live demo: two short flows (10m)
30:00 - customer mini-case (5m)
35:00 - panel Q&A + CTA (10m)
```
Elena S.: customer case: 5-min story about moving to dedicated and cost reduction + SLA win. I'll coordinate with CS for permissions.
Maya Li: logistics: registration fields -> company, role, size, hosting_interest, primary_challenge. map to "inbound-webinar" queue. add hidden utm param for source tracking.
Asha Verma: rehearsals: tech check (20m) 3 days prior, full dress (45m) 2 days prior, greenroom 15m before. need slides 5 days before.
Ben Torres: marketing tests: two subject lines + two landing pages (technical vs ROI). measure registration->attend rate and demo conversion. also track which slide's CTA gets clicks.
Cara Liu: creative needs: hero image, 6 social cards, 1 short demo gif, two landing pages. deadline: assets in drive by next Wed.
Diego Ramos: demo fallback: pre-recorded flows + engineer in greenroom for live fallback. will prep rollback script.
Elena S.: I'll line up the customer and get approval for a short quote and logo.
Maya Li: routing rules: company_size>500 OR hosting_interest=="private" -> AE enterprise queue. sandbox requests -> Solutions Eng. will add webhook mapping snippet to ops.
Nora-bot: calendar event created: "Inference Economics  final rehearsal" scheduled 2024-09-10T16:00Z. Link: https://calendar.redwoodinference/internal/inf-econ-456
Asha Verma: next steps: Cara to draft abstracts + speaker brief, Diego to build demo scripts, Ben to draft benchmark slides, Maya to set up reg form & tracking. check-in in this thread by Fri.
Ben Torres: I'll also draft a short post-webinar follow-up flow: recording, clips, bench blog link, sandbox invite.
Asha Verma: thanks all. will post promo copy draft here tomorrow for quick review. :rocket:
